clue.text: Less familiar way to meet worker in park

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
a ranger patrols and looks after a national park

explanation.surface: Directions for meeting a park ranger along an unfamiliar route.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of strange: something stranger is less known or less familiar to you.

clue.text: United drew

definitions.meaning: joined or bound together, as with a knot
finished a match level, with neither side winning

explanation.surface: A football report: United drew.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: knotted things are joined, and a level match is one where the scores finish even.

clue.text: Come up against an objection

parts.note: the indefinite article an gives A
a but is an objection, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: Meeting opposition in the form of an objection.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that adjoin or touch at the edge come up against each other, a synonym.

clue.text: Refined chap, slippery type

parts.note: a gent is a chap, a man
an eel is proverbially slippery

explanation.surface: A polished gentleman who turns out to be a slippery customer.
explanation.definitionFit: Genteel means polite and refined in manner, often with a hint of affectation.

clue.text: Cure the heart-sore lot suffering

indicators.note: suffering suggests the letters are in a bad state, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remedy for the whole lot of heartbroken sufferers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' rearranges the fifteen letters of THE HEART-SORE LOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To cure someone is to bring them back to good health, a verbal phrase synonym.

clue.text: Jar for this berry?

definitions.meaning: to grate harshly on the ear, like a coarse file
put this word before berry and you get the red soft fruit

explanation.surface: A jam jar set aside for a particular fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a playful hint: the word needed, placed in front of 'berry', makes the fruit's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A rasp is a harsh grating sound or file, and to jar is to grate on the senses.

clue.text: Princely payment?

parts.note: princely suggests lavish, but also points to the royal family; the payment is the fee an author earns per copy sold

explanation.walkthrough: 'Princely' reads as 'generous', but the clue also hints at kings and princes, while the answer names an author's per-sale fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A royalty is a payment to an author or patent holder, and princes are royals.

clue.text: Turn on or off, then reverse to find railway

parts.note: to switch is to turn a device on or off
to back is to reverse, as a car backs up

explanation.surface: Instructions for operating and backing a train onto a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A switchback is a roller-coaster or zigzag mountain railway that turns back on itself.

clue.text: One who is working at last

definitions.text: One who is working at last

parts.words: One who is working at last
parts.note: at last seems to mean finally employed, but a last is the foot-shaped block on which footwear is made

explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' reads as 'finally'; here a last is the cobbler's foot-shaped form.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobbler builds boots over a last, the wooden foot model, so works at it.

clue.text: Unusual question — not to one that sparkles?

indicators.note: unusual tells us the letters are arranged in an uncommon order

parts.note: taken as written
the word to, which 'not' tells us to take away from the pool

explanation.surface: An odd question about something that glitters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not to' removes T and O from QUESTION; 'Unusual' rearranges what is left, QUESIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A sequin is a small shiny disc sewn on clothing, so it sparkles.

clue.text: Star perhaps in top window

definitions.meaning: a star is one example of a light seen in the heavens
a window set in a roof or ceiling

explanation.surface: Seeing a star through a high window.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a light in the heavens and a roof window letting daylight in.

clue.text: Did not forget and picked up again

definitions.meaning: gathered together a second time, re- plus collected

explanation.surface: Remembering to fetch something you had dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense means remembered; split as re-collected it means gathered once more.

clue.text: Type of betting established inequality

parts.note: fixed means settled or established
odds can mean a disparity or inequality, as in 'against the odds'

explanation.surface: A gambling system said to be founded on unfairness.
explanation.definitionFit: Fixed-odds betting is a wager where the payout ratio is agreed when the bet is placed.

clue.text: Acquisition of rough mat in a tent

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters are roughly handled and jumbled

explanation.surface: Buying a rough mat for the floor of a tent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rough' rearranges the letters of MAT IN A TENT.
explanation.definitionFit: An attainment is something gained or achieved, an acquisition.

clue.text: Factory still dry i.e. peculiar!

indicators.note: peculiar means odd, so the letters take an odd arrangement

explanation.surface: A factory with a still that is dry, which is peculiar.
explanation.definitionFit: A distillery is a works where spirits such as whisky are produced, a kind of factory.

clue.text: Dickens will accept article for Ruth's husband

indicators.note: will accept means the first piece takes the second into its middle

parts.note: Boz was the pen name Charles Dickens used for his early sketches
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Dickens agreeing to take an article about the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Ruth, Boaz marries Ruth the Moabite.

clue.text: 10, say, entering Virginia

definitions.note: a cross-reference to 10-across, whose clue begins 'Star perhaps'

indicators.note: entering means the second piece goes into the first

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
say is a signal for e.g., for example

explanation.surface: A cross-reference to another clue, said to be entering Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: '10' sends you to 10-across, clued as 'Star perhaps'; the answer is a star.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is a bright star in the constellation Lyra, a light in the night sky.

clue.text: Boring bird?

parts.note: boring seems to mean dull, but means drilling holes, as this bird does to tree trunks

explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' looks like 'dull'; here it means drilling into timber with the beak.
explanation.definitionFit: This bird hammers its beak into trees, literally boring holes in wood.

clue.text: Witty fellow covering part of leg for cleaning

indicators.note: covering means the first piece wraps round the second

parts.note: a wag is a joker, a witty person
the shin is the front of the lower leg

explanation.surface: A joker hiding a bruised shin so it can be cleaned.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing is the act of cleaning with water, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Course not to be taken by drivers

definitions.text: Course not to be taken by drivers

parts.words: Course not to be taken by drivers
parts.note: course suggests a golf course where drivers are clubs, but it means a route for walkers, not motorists

explanation.walkthrough: 'drivers' and 'Course' hint at golf; really it is a route for people on foot, not cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A footpath or track is a route for walkers, closed to motor traffic.

clue.text: Connoisseurs, one hundred with terrible congestion

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for one hundred

indicators.note: terrible suggests the letters are in a dreadful mess

explanation.surface: A hundred wine experts stuck in a terrible traffic jam.
explanation.definitionFit: The cognoscenti are people with expert knowledge, a borrowed Italian term for experts.

clue.text: About four, I, in France, dance

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: je is French for I
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four friends, myself included, dancing in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Jive is a lively swing dance popular from the 1940s.

clue.text: Another pew seating elder initially in part of church

indicators.note: initially means take the opening letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: An extra pew to seat the church elder.
explanation.definitionFit: The apse is the semicircular recess at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Advantage facing high ground in Civil War battle

parts.note: an edge is an advantage, as in 'having the edge'
a hill is a piece of high ground

explanation.surface: Holding the high ground gives an edge in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: Edgehill (1642) in Warwickshire was the first major battle of the English Civil War.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgehill is the name of the opening pitched battle of the English Civil War.

clue.text: Flexible western dropout?

parts.note: a hippy is a classic dropout from conventional society

explanation.surface: A laid-back Western dropout.
explanation.definitionFit: Whippy describes something springy and bendy, like a cane, so flexible.

clue.text: Good person — and a good party

parts.note: ST, for saint, is a good person

explanation.surface: Praise for a good person and a good party.
explanation.walkthrough: A stag (night or party) is the British term for a groom's men-only celebration before his wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag is a pre-wedding party for the groom and his male friends.

clue.text: Coward's work that could make one sniffy

definitions.meaning: a comedy by the playwright Noël Coward
an allergy to pollen which causes a runny nose

explanation.surface: A play by a coward that leaves the audience sniffing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coward' is not a timid person but Noël Coward, the English playwright, whose 1925 comedy bears this name.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both Coward's 1925 comedy and the pollen allergy that makes people sniffle.
